AnchorSpringProfile.description: Elastic tension-only anchor stiffness; coordinates relative to plate centre.
AnchorSpringProfile.title: AnchorSpringProfile

ProjectSiteProfile.description:
Persisted, traceable project-wide climate and seismic assumptions.

Version 1.1 permits a project to collect conditions in stages.  Individual
scene calculations enforce only the conditions they use, so the service
never fabricates a climate or seismic value for an unrelated scene.
ProjectSiteProfile.title: ProjectSiteProfile

SceneConditionProfile.description:
Condition requirements and semantic inputs for one scene variant.

This catalog metadata is intentionally declarative: the frontend can
render a scene-specific project-condition form without encoding a branch
for every scene family, and the calculation service can enforce the same
requirements before executing a graph.
SceneConditionProfile.title: SceneConditionProfile

TypedInputValue.description:
Schema 3.1 numeric input at the API boundary.

Legacy calculations still consume ``inputs`` internally.  The adapter
below converts these values while preserving their declared units for
validation and reporting.
TypedInputValue.title: TypedInputValue

TypedModuleInputs.description: Compatibility adapter for existing Schema 3.2 calculation modules.
TypedModuleInputs.title: TypedModuleInputs
